title: Add About Me page with creator bio and link from layout

requirements.text: Create a new About page that displays the provided “About Me” bio/mission text for Genuine Being Real, including the debut novel mention (“Shining Gaze – A Search for the Unknown”).

quotes:
About Me

I am an author and storyteller, and the creator of Genuine Being Real — a platform dedicated to sharing real, anonymous stories and emotions. My debut novel, Shining Gaze – A Search for the Unknown, reflects my belief in emotional resilience, self-discovery, and the power of untold stories.

Through this platform, I aim to create a safe space where people can share experiences they may not always be able to express openly. My goal is to build a community rooted in honesty, empathy, and meaningful conversations, where every story finds understanding and respect.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to an About route renders an About page with the full user-provided text in English, preserving punctuation and meaning (including “Genuine Being Real” and “Shining Gaze – A Search for the Unknown”).
The About page layout matches the existing warm editorial theme (typography, spacing, background colors) and is readable on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Add an /about route to the TanStack Router configuration and wire it to the new About page component.
acceptanceCriteria: The app has a new route at /about that is reachable via client-side navigation (no full page reload required).

requirements.text: Add a visible navigation entry point to the About page from the global layout footer (and keep existing footer content intact).
acceptanceCriteria: The footer includes an “About” link (English label) that navigates to /about.
The existing footer line “© 2026. Built with love using caffeine.ai” remains present and functional.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not edit immutable hook/bootstrap files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Changing backend data models or adding new backend APIs.
Adding third-party integrations or external CMS/content sources.
Redesigning existing pages beyond what’s necessary to add the About page and link.
